# Native mask source

Unchanged Adobe-native fixture and independent AE-exported JSON sidecar from MIT
`forticheprod/py-aep` at commit `e12a451c35bacd3f34a080090265f9370e66162b`.
`provenance.json` pins source paths, SHA-256 and byte counts. The source includes
multiple explicit mask atoms and the sidecar records their editable paths, modes,
inversion, feather, opacity, expansion and RotoBezier metadata. This is structural
evidence only; no new Adobe/UI/render run or alpha/fidelity scoring was performed.
